remarks: Tucked into the desirable Pine Tree Village community, this fully furnished 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhome delivers the four-season Ellicottville lifestyle buyers are chasing. Built in 1977 and offering approximately 988 square feet of smartly designed living space, this property blends comfort, function, and investment potential in one turnkey package. Step inside to a warm, open main living area designed for gathering after a day on the slopes or trails. The eat-in kitchen flows easily into the living and dining space, creating an inviting layout for entertaining. Upstairs, you’ll find three bedrooms, a full bath, and convenient laundry — maximizing both owner use and guest flexibility. Outdoor living is just as appealing, featuring a partially covered deck perfect for grilling, relaxing, or storing seasonal gear. A spacious yard and additional storage shed provide room for all the extras that come with ski country ownership. This freehold townhouse offers added value with minimal overhead — no traditional HOA fees and shared low-cost services for mowing and snowplowing. Even more attractive for investors, the property sits outside village limits, opening the door for flexible rental opportunities. Located just minutes from the Village of Ellicottville, Holiday Valley, and HoliMont, this is the ideal basecamp — whether you’re looking for a personal getaway, income producer, or both.
